name: Burnette
source:
Accomplished biochemist and [url=https://vndb.org/c17485]Rose's[/url] mother. She might seem a little serious, but she actually has a good sense of humor.
[spoiler]She used to work with a woman named Rosemary and is happy to rekindle their friendship after all these years.[spoiler]
